AUTOMATIC TRANSAXLE
23A-347
>>B<< KEY INTERLOCK CABLE (SELECTOR LEVER SIDE) 
INSTALLATION
1. Install the key interlock cable on the lock cam.
2. Install the spring and washer of the key interlock cable as 
shown.
3. While lightly pushing the cable coupling portion of the lock 
cam in the direction A, tighten the nut to the specified 
torque.
Tightening torque: 12 ± 2 N⋅m (102 ± 22 in-lb)
>>C<< NUT INSTALLATION
1. Put the selector lever in the "N" position.
2. Loosen the nut. Gently pull the transaxle control cable in the 
direction of the arrow until the cable is taut. Tighten the nut 
at the specified torque.
Tightening torque: 12 ± 2 N⋅m (102 ± 22 in-lb)
